name: Okimiya Ichi
source:
A man who was a big fan of Sakina's character Natsuno Hidamari.
His extreme service has turned him into a fan of Gachi-Koi.
He has no idea that Sakina's services were part of her job or sales,
Even after his sudden retirement, he continues to hold one-sided love for her as a fan.
At the beginning of the story, he is a virgin.
